name: Ton Diepeveen - § 46 - Am 5
title: REPORT on the decarbonisation and modernisation of EU fisheries, and the development and deployment of fishing gear
part_text: 46. Emphasises the need to make voluntary energy-efficiency advice available to operators under the EMFAF; insists that optimisation and retrofitting operations must be encouraged wherever possible in order to improve the energy efficiency of vessels and promote the use of technologies, in particular AI;
